title: Stable graded harmonic multiplicities on complex cyclic quivers are weighted distinguished-tableau sums
author: Frohmader, Andrew; Heaton, Alexander
work: Stable graded multiplicities for harmonics on a cyclic quiver

difficulty_reason: The proof reorganizes cyclic products of Littlewood–Richardson crystal sets by a least dominant weight, explicitly parametrizes every compatible partition tuple by one free partition, and cancels the invariant Euler factor. The full cyclic crystal separation-of-variables bijection is retained, yielding a positive stable harmonic-multiplicity formula.
